thread:
Ava (product): Heads-up — BigCorp just asked for a tenant-level version lock (they want no automatic model swaps) for 90 days, plus a rollback guarantee and credits if we migrate them early. Can we sketch a proposal (tech + product + comms) and launch criteria?
Carlos (eng): We can add a tenant_override routing key that pins a tenant to a model version. Main risks: KV/cache invalidation, extra capacity footprint, and autoscaler interactions.
Priya (ml): Also need to call out eval risks — a locked older model can regress on hallucination/QA checks vs new releases. We should define a benchmark gate (quality + latency) for any lock extension.
Jules (customer-suc): BigCorp says 90d non-negotiable unless we offer credits. They want a pilot.
Ava (product): Proposal draft: default tenant_lock window 60d; 90d available as an enterprise SOW add-on with costs/credits. Add an "escape_hatch" that lets customer and Redwood trigger emergency rollback and notifications. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Carlos (eng): Implementation sketch: tenant_override table with fields (tenant_id, model_id, expires_at, escape_hatch_flags). Need API + console controls + per-tenant routing precedence. Estimate: infra + API ~3w, console ~1w, QA/rollout ~1w. If prioritized can compress.
Priya (ml): Bench plan: nightly A/B runs of the tenant's top N prompts against candidate model. Require perf gate: latency <= +15% and quality drop <= 1% on our eval metric (we'll use eval-suite accuracy + hallucination rate). I'll draft the eval thresholds and a small benchmark harness for tenant prompts.
Jules (customer-suc): BigCorp will accept 60d if we add a 7-day advance notice before any forced migration. Pilot acceptance target: May pilot (2 tenants).
Ava (product): Required launch criteria (first pass): 1) API + routing implemented, 2) Console UI for locks + notifications, 3) Bench harness + gating, 4) Comms + SOW template, 5) Ops cap/alerts for locked-model saturation.
Carlos (eng): Ops note: we need a soft cap per-region for locked instances. If too many tenants lock onto older heavy models we may exhaust reserved pools. Recommend cap + auto-alert + migration suggestion flow.
Priya (ml): UI/Observability: surface per-tenant quality delta in Console (daily). Also add a per-tenant sample prompt set for ongoing regression checks.
Ava (product): Action items: Priya -> bench thresholds PR by Mon; Carlos -> GH issue with API/infra tasks and rough sprint plan; Jules -> draft SOW & pilot comms. I'll sync with sales for pricing offsets. :thumbsup: 
Carlos (eng): Example routing override prototype (for API/ops docs):
```
{
  "tenant_id": "bigcorp",
  "model_override": "redwood-x-3.1-quant-v1",
  "expires_at": "2026-06-30T00:00:00Z",
  "escape_hatch": { "by_customer": true, "by_redwood": false }
}
```
Priya (ml): Also include per-tenant golden prompts in the harness. If the locked model starts failing gate, auto-email SRE + customer and block further lock renewals.
deploy-bot: created pipeline for issue #5123 (tenant-locking-api) — build queued.
Ava (product): Decision draft: allow tenant locks with caps + bench gates + advance-notice + SOW for extended locks; include credits policy for >60d. I'll write RFC this week and propose opt-in pilot gates.
Carlos (eng): Rough total dev effort 4-5 sprints if medium priority. If Sales pushes urgent pilot we can deliver a minimal MVP in ~6 weeks (API + basic UI + manual ops runbook).
Jules (customer-suc): I'll loop in BigCorp PM today and request their sample prompt set. They want pilot start in early May.
Ava (product): Great. Leaving this thread as the coordination point. Ping here with PRs/links and I'll collate into the RFC.
